name: Shrikant Pawade
tagline: Pianist by training, building with AI, learning in public from Pune.
intro: About a year ago I left a career in music to learn how language models are trained, by building small ones and fine-tuning them on my own data. This site is where the work goes, including the parts that fail.
description: Shrikant Pawade, a pianist turned AI builder in Pune. Projects, essays and notes on training small language models.
